Package index

All functions

ACCESS_FORBIDDEN_TERMS
Normative terms that must NOT be applied to an accessibility result without a defensible demand target (there is none in this study).
ACCESS_SAFE_LABELS
Approved, non-normative labels for E2SFCA / accessibility outputs
DENOMINATOR_CATEGORY
Total-female access-table denominator category label
DJ7_BANDS
Isochrone travel-time bands (minutes).
DJ7_NAME2CODE
Board-certification subspecialty name -> analysis code.
DJ7_SUBS
Display order of the seven OB/GYN subspecialties.
DJ7_WC_BASE
Primary cumulative Gaussian band weights (30/60/120/180 min).
E2SFCA_DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS
Default access thresholds (in per-100k units) for cell-level population shares.
E2SFCA_DEFAULT_WEIGHTS
Default cumulative-band distance-decay weights (Gaussian-shaped, monotone).
TRACT_REACHED_COVERAGE_PCT
Tract "reached"/"covered" population-coverage threshold (percent)
